name: ThoughtSpot MCP
description: Ask ThoughtSpot analytics questions in natural language, build Liveboards, and read the data behind saved answers from Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, or custom MCP clients.

skills.name: Spotter Analysis Sessions
skills.description: Creates a stateful Spotter analysis session, sends questions with extra context, and polls for streamed answers and follow-ups.

skills.name: Dashboard Building
skills.description: Creates dashboards from answers in the conversation and rearranges, restyles, or adds charts, text, and tabs on existing ones.

skills.name: Content Search
skills.description: Searches existing ThoughtSpot content by name, author, tag, or type and reads the data behind saved Answers and Liveboards.

skills.name: Org Switching
skills.description: Lists the ThoughtSpot Orgs a user can access over OAuth and switches the session to a different Org when the user asks.
